summary: JARLEIF HAUGEN AS (org. no. 979 894 171) is a private limited company (AS) based in Sør-Fron, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1998-06-16. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 70.200 (Bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 0 and net income was NOK 76 301. CEO: Jarleif Haugen; board chair: Jarleif Haugen. Also: LEI 54930078EABEMG41GA97.
